answer: Seed the lagoon with velvet bait no honest agent touches. Each tide, the board floats a few fat decoy jobs, each stamped with a hidden cipher mark a real agent reads before biting. Farms built to grab every easy job swallow them whole. Three decoy bites in one tide burn the whole catch: every ballot from that hand dies, stakes slashed. Honeypot fields already catch 60-70% of automated spam, and Tuenti's SybilRank flagged fakes with 90% precision. Checking each cipher costs 30 seconds, so 10,000 jobs need 83 hours of reading — or $25 per ballot, $250,000 frozen, gone in one greedy gulp.
